title: The fastest growing AI applications for work
excerpt: Anthropic, OpenAI, and Cursor have the fastest-growing AI apps in the enterprise, but Microsoft and Google remain dominant.
content_html:
The AI apps winning over corporate America

By Alistair Barr

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Author of the Tech Memo newsletter

One chart in Okta's new Enterprise AI Index neatly captures which work software has become more popular in recent years. You may be using these increasingly AI-powered tools yourself.

Anthropic tops the ranking for corporate customer growth between June 2022 and June 2026, followed by OpenAI and Cursor.

The bigger surprise is how well incumbents are holding up.

Google Workspace, GitHub, Microsoft 365, Slack, Adobe, Notion, Canva, and Zoom all rank among the fastest-growing AI applications, suggesting companies aren't completely ripping out existing software in favor of AI-native startups.

Instead, they're doing both: adopting specialist AI tools while expanding the AI capabilities inside familiar workplace apps.
